```{r}
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)



path = "csv_export/"

omega    = read_csv(paste0(path, "OMEGA.csv"))
drg      = read_csv(paste0(path, "DRG.csv"))
crit     = read_csv(paste0(path, "CRIT.csv"))
ome_dx   = read_csv(paste0(path, "OME_DX.csv"))
ome_px   = read_csv(paste0(path, "OME_PX.csv"))
dx11     = read_csv(paste0(path, "9DX11.csv"))
op11     = read_csv(paste0(path, "9OP11.csv"))
dispostn = read_csv(paste0(path, "DISPOSTN.csv"))
service  = read_csv(paste0(path, "SERVICE.csv"))
source   = read_csv(paste0(path, "SOURCE.csv"))
mdclist = read_excel("data.xlsx")
```



```{r}
# link newborns to their mother

omega_clean = omega %>% distinct()
newborn_mother = omega_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(MOTHER_MRN) & MOTHER_MRN != 0) %>%
  select(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, MOTHER_MRN, TOT_CHARGE, TOT_COST, TOT_PAY)

mother_records = omega_clean %>%
  select(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, TOT_CHARGE, TOT_COST, TOT_PAY) %>%
  rename(mother_pat_no = PAT_NO,
         mother_adm_date = ADM_DATE,
         mother_charge = TOT_CHARGE,
         mother_cost = TOT_COST,
         mother_pay = TOT_PAY)

linked = newborn_mother %>%
  left_join(mother_records, by = c("MOTHER_MRN" = "mother_pat_no"))




```
```{r}
linked = newborn_mother %>%
  left_join(mother_records, by = c("MOTHER_MRN" = "mother_pat_no"),
            relationship = "many-to-many")
```

```{r}
# check that MOTHER_MRN exists in omega_clean as a PAT_NO
linked %>%
  summarise(
    total_newborns        = n(),
    mother_found          = sum(!is.na(mother_charge)),
    mother_not_found      = sum(is.na(mother_charge)),
    pct_mother_found      = round(mean(!is.na(mother_charge)) * 100, 1)
  )
```
```{r}
linked %>%
  distinct(MOTHER_MRN) %>%
  left_join(omega_clean %>% select(PAT_NO) %>% rename(found = PAT_NO), 
            by = c("MOTHER_MRN" = "found")) %>%
  summarise(
    total_mothers  = n(),
    found_in_omega = sum(!is.na(MOTHER_MRN)),
    not_found      = sum(is.na(MOTHER_MRN))
  )
```




```{r}
linked %>%
  mutate(
    ADM_DATE_dt        = as.Date(ADM_DATE, format = "%m/%d/%y"),
    mother_adm_date_dt = as.Date(mother_adm_date, format = "%m/%d/%y"),
    days_diff          = as.numeric(ADM_DATE_dt - mother_adm_date_dt)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_days_diff = round(mean(days_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    min_days_diff = min(days_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_days_diff = max(days_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    within_3_days = sum(abs(days_diff) <= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_within_3  = round(mean(abs(days_diff) <= 3, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
  )


omega_clean %>% filter(PAT_NO == 0)



```




```{r}
# Service line assignment
omega_clean = omega %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    DISTANCE   = ifelse(DISTANCE > 65534, NA, DISTANCE),
    TOT_CHARGE = ifelse(TOT_CHARGE < 0, NA, TOT_CHARGE),
    TOT_PAY    = ifelse(TOT_PAY < 0, NA, TOT_PAY),
    TOT_COST   = ifelse(TOT_COST < 0, NA, TOT_COST),
    RACE       = ifelse(RACE == "UNKNOWN", NA, RACE)
  )

# Join DRG and MDCLIST
drg_mdc = drg %>%
  left_join(
    mdclist %>% select(mdc_code, service_line),
    by = c("MAJ_DX_CAT" = "mdc_code")
  )

# Profit and LOS outlier
omega_main = omega_clean %>%
  left_join(drg_mdc, by = "DRG") %>%
  mutate(
    profit      = TOT_PAY - TOT_COST,
    los_outlier = ifelse(LOS > CUTOFF, 1, 0)
  )

# Aggregate CRIT
crit_agg = crit %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_icu_days = sum(ICU_LOS, na.rm = TRUE),
    icu_stays      = n(),
    .groups        = "drop"
  )

# Aggregate OME_DX
ome_dx_agg = ome_dx %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_diagnoses = max(TOT_NO_DXS, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_dx_codes = n_distinct(DIAGNOSIS),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

# Aggregate OME_PX
ome_px_agg = ome_px %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_ops      = max(TOT_NO_OPS, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_op_codes = n_distinct(OP_PROC_9),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

# Newborn linkage
newborn_mother = omega_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(MOTHER_MRN) & MOTHER_MRN != 0) %>%
  select(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, MOTHER_MRN, TOT_CHARGE, TOT_COST, TOT_PAY)

mother_records = omega_clean %>%
  select(PAT_NO, ADM_DATE, TOT_CHARGE, TOT_COST, TOT_PAY) %>%
  rename(mother_pat_no   = PAT_NO,
         mother_adm_date = ADM_DATE,
         mother_charge   = TOT_CHARGE,
         mother_cost     = TOT_COST,
         mother_pay      = TOT_PAY)

linked = newborn_mother %>%
  left_join(mother_records,
            by           = c("MOTHER_MRN" = "mother_pat_no", "ADM_DATE" = "mother_adm_date"),
            relationship = "many-to-many")

# Final join
df_full = omega_main %>%
  left_join(crit_agg,    by = c("PAT_NO", "ADM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(ome_dx_agg,  by = c("PAT_NO", "ADM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(ome_px_agg,  by = c("PAT_NO", "ADM_DATE")) %>%
  left_join(dispostn %>% rename(dispostn_desc   = DESCRIPT), by = "DISPOSTN") %>%
  left_join(source   %>% rename(adm_source_desc = DESCRIPT), by = "ADM_SOURCE") %>%
  left_join(service  %>% rename(adm_svc_desc    = DESCRIPT), by = c("ADM_SVC" = "SERVICE"))
```
